title: Business For Good (Paul Shapiro) — 'The more successful an organization becomes, the more valuable it becomes as a target'
summary: Paul Shapiro — Better Meat Co. CEO and Business For Good host — drops a 53-minute Eric episode covering mission-hopeful vs. mission-driven, whether nonprofits are as capture-prone as for-profits, Adopt-a-Pet's Lean-Startup pedigree, Beyond Meat's pivot to protein water, why independent directors have statistically failed to prevent corporate corruption, and what governance can learn from ancient sortition.
blockquote: The more successful an organization becomes, the more valuable it becomes as a target. It becomes something worth stealing or in the book corrupting.
blockquote_source: Eric Ries on the Business For Good Podcast
attribution_title: CEO, Better Meat Co.; host, Business For Good Podcast
